title: Choose the homepage composition
question: The visual world is fixed. Choose which information hierarchy should become the responsive implementation.

options.label: Grid First
options.thesis: The familiar category filters flow directly into a large, immediately useful tool matrix.
options.viewport: Centered concise introduction, category filters, then two complete rows of tools with writing beginning at the fold.
options.risk: The most conventional composition; distinction must come from exact craft and Florian’s concise authorship.

options.label: Search First
options.thesis: A wide search control becomes the fastest route into a catalogue designed for dozens of tools.
options.viewport: Compact title, prominent search and categories, Featured tools, then a denser All tools index before writing.
options.risk: More scalable, but less visual emphasis on Florian’s personal profile.

options.label: Category-led Shelves
options.thesis: A compact personal introduction and category launcher share one band before the tools take over.
options.viewport: Split introduction and search/categories, one Featured row, a compact Browse all tools shelf, then writing.
options.risk: The split introduction is more authored, but slightly less immediate than a single centered hierarchy.
